rows.title_short: \"Anti-Cyber Trafficking Act of 2007\"
rows.abstract: The bill proposes to impose the following penalties: a) imprisonment of two (2) to five (5) years and a fine of not less than P500,000 but not more than P1 million on any performer, actor or exhibitor of an indecent act; b) imprisonment of 15 to 20 years and a fine of not less than P1 million but not more than P2 million on the internet service provider or website operator; and c) imprisonment of 20 to 30 years and a fine of not less than P2 million but not more than P5 million on the producer or promoter of cyber-trafficking.

rows.title_full: AN ACT TO HASTEN TITLING OF RESIDENTIAL LANDS OF THE PUBLIC DOMAIN BY EXTENDING THE GRANT OF FREE PATENT TO RESIDENTIAL LANDS UNDER CERTAIN CONDITIONS
rows.abstract: The bill proposes the following:  a) extend the grant of free patent to residential lands classified as such by the local government in its land use plan and not needed for public service and use; b) reduce the period of occupation to ten (10) years; and c) remove the restriction on encumbrance in the title.
